name: Lynn Yap
reason: Too thin and mainly coaching: her site is built around life coaching, 'processing' and corporate training, her yoga, sound-therapy and meditation services have no pages of their own (every Book Now goes to the contact form), the only sound-healing event listed is a past 2025 class led by a visiting teacher, and her one book is a confidence-coaching title sold through her shop and Singapore bookshops, so fewer than three spiritual items would pass.
